description:
Update one of this shop's listings: its title, text, price, district, condition, photos or a job's salary.

Send its id and only the fields to change; the rest stay as they are, and changes are saved at once. Photos you send replace the whole set. A phone number in the title or contact details in the text are refused, and long text is shortened (title 140 characters, text 5,000). A refused edit changes nothing and returns its reason code, such as `title_too_short` or `invalid_price`. It cannot change a subcategory or the licence values, nor the category or the status (use set_listing_status for that).

Returns `held` and `unpublished`, which say when the saved edit is not public yet (`held: true` while the listing waits for eno's licence check), and `listing` as it now stands: `id`, `title`, `description`, `price`, `priceUnit`, `district`, `condition`, `images`, `status`, `verified`, `url` and the rest of get_listing's fields.

condition.description: The item's condition: "new", "like_new" or "used". Send an empty string to clear it, or leave it out to keep it

description.description: The new text for the listing page, in the seller's words. Leave it out to keep the current text

district.description: Where the item is, as a district or area. Send an empty string to clear it, or leave it out to keep it

id.description: The listing to change: its id (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`), from list_listings or create_listing

images.description: The complete new set of photo URLs, in display order; it replaces the current photos. To add one, send the current `images` from get_listing plus the new URL. Leave it out to keep them

price.description: The new asking price in VND (for a job: its monthly salary in VND). Leave it out to keep the current price

salaryM.description: A job's monthly salary in whole millions of VND (25 = 25.000.000 đ); it wins over `price`. Send null to remove it, or leave it out to keep it

title.description: The new headline buyers see first. Leave it out to keep the current one

name: update_listing

held.description: true when the edit is saved but the listing stays unpublished until eno's licence check approves it; false otherwise

category.description: The category the listing is filed under, which decides where buyers find it on the site

name.description: The category's English name, as buyers see it on the site, e.g. "Electronics"; use it when you name the category to the seller

slug.description: The category's slug, e.g. "electronics" or "rentals": the value create_listing takes as categorySlug, and the one to compare listings by

city.description: The city or province the listing is in, e.g. "Hồ Chí Minh" or "Hà Nội"; with district it says where a buyer would collect or view the item

condition.description: The item's condition, e.g. "new", "like_new" or "used" (the three a seller picks on eno; an older listing may carry the seller's own words); null when none was given, as for a job or a service. update_listing can set it

contactCount.description: Leads, all time: how many different signed-in buyers opened the seller's contact from it

description.description: The text on the listing page, in the seller's own words: what it is, its state, what comes with it. An empty string when the seller wrote none; update_listing can add it

district.description: The district or area the item is in, as buyers search by it, e.g. "Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức"; null when none was given, which update_listing can fill

id.description: The listing id (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`); pass it to get_listing, update_listing, set_listing_status or delete_listing

images.description: Photo URLs in display order. To keep them through an edit, send this list back to update_listing

listingType.description: What the listing offers. sell: an item for sale. rent: for rent. free: given away. wanted: someone looking to buy or rent. wholesale: sold in bulk. service: a service. job: a job opening. event: an event. teacher: a teacher's profile

location.description: The place as shown on the listing page, for display; use district and city to compare or filter listings

negotiable.description: Whether buyers may send offers below the price; always false for a job or a wanted ad

postedAt.description: When it was first listed, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, e.g. "2026-11-17T08:30:00.000Z"; buyers see newer listings first, so it tells how fresh the listing looks

price.description: The asking price in Vietnamese đồng (VND); for a job, its monthly salary in VND. Show it with priceUnit, formatted as VND (e.g. 12.000.000 đ)

priceUnit.description: What the price is for: "VND" for a one-off price, "VND/month" (and similar) for a rent or a salary. Always show it beside the price, so a monthly rent is never read as a sale price

status.description: active: on sale (public once verified). sold: kept on the site, marked sold. hidden: off the site but not deleted; set_listing_status moves a listing between these three. Any other value, such as expired or stale, means eno took the listing off the site

subcategorySlug.description: The subcategory within that category, as a slug, e.g. "phones-tablets" in electronics; null when the listing is filed under the category alone

title.description: The headline buyers see in search results and at the top of the listing page; use it when you name the listing to the seller. update_listing changes it

url.description: The listing's page on eno, a full https URL; share it with buyers once the listing is public (verified true and status active), since before that it shows them nothing

verified.description: false while the listing waits for eno's check and is not public yet; true once eno has published it

video.description: The listing's video as a full URL, played on its page before the photos; null when it has none (videos are added on the site, not through these tools)

views.description: How many times its page has been viewed since it was listed, all time; with contactCount it shows how well the listing is doing, and analytics_listings gives them day by day

listing.description: The listing as it now stands, the same fields get_listing returns; null only if it could not be read back

unpublished.description: true when the listing belongs to an account whose listings are not shown publicly; false otherwise

title: Update marketplace listing
